ns2:course.label: Anth Theory Form&Argumentation
ns2:course.description: Exploration of current theory in social and cultural anthropology, with emphasis on examining theories in the light of contemporary ideas about theoretical adequacy and of the historical development of anthropological thought; designed especially for anthropology majors and anthropology graduate students. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANTH 230 or equivalent.
